norm: the completion of the future occurs only after complete memory cleanup
assumption: The completion of the Future occurs only after complete memory cleanup.
rationale: SWS_DM_00671 defines the asynchronous return via Future, while SWS_DM_00162 specifies that positive deletion feedback may only occur after complete memory cleanup.
